note: spoken VO, distinct from the on-screen captions; one clip per run of shots

clips.text: You looked at shoes. Now they're everywhere.
Not mind-reading. One small file: a cookie. A note a site leaves in your browser.
It says: same person as before. That's how you stay logged in.
Same note, second site. Same company. Two visits, one identity. That's the trick.
That's a third-party cookie. A number, not your name. Incognito forgets on your device, not theirs.
You see the shoes, not the exact pair. The standard calls it worrisome. Safari, Firefox and Brave block these.
Apps have their own switch, in your settings. Blocking rarely breaks anything.
You don't need to understand it all. One note, every site, one switch. The shoes can't follow if the note can't travel.
